meta.name: Lucky Romance
meta.description:
To protect her sister from endless misfortune, a superstitious woman must find a specific man chosen by fate. She crosses paths with a cold tech CEO who relies strictly on math and science, loathing all things irrational. To ward off her bad luck, she proposes an unexpected contract relationship. As these two opposites draw closer, their clash of science and superstition turns into an unpredictable romance that challenges their beliefs.

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Shim Bo-nui searches at a casino for her boss who ran off with her salary. Meanwhile, Je Soo Ho is about to announce his company's new game, Genius II. Two of the engineers try to steal the software on the day of Soo Ho's presentation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After Bo-nui's attempt to catch a tiger ends in failure, pro tennis player Choi Gun-wook moves into her apartment building.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bo-nui lets Soo-ho into her room after mistaking him for her date, but now Gun-wook waits outside. Bo-nui frantically stops Soo-ho from leaving.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bo-nui agrees to the contract on the condition that Soo-ho dates her for three weeks. She tells him that it's a matter of life and death.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After seeing Soo-ho's gentle side Bo-nui asks him to spend the night, only to be refused. Gun-wook takes the downcast Bo-nui to the tennis court.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bo-nui tries to apologize to Soo-ho and tells him the truth but he drives away. Soo-ho can't keep his mind off her and follows her after work.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Bo-nui despairs as the full moon arrives without her accomplishing her task to save her sister. Soo-ho worries for her as she heads out into the rain.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Resigned to Bo-ra's fate, Bo-nui heads down to the river alone. The next day she returns a missed call from the hospital and receives some news.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Thanks to Soo-ho being her talisman, Bo-nui is able to see her sister. Touched by his kindness, she talks about her past as they sit in the park.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After spending the night watching over Soo-ho, Bo-nui is late for Gun-wook's TV appearance the next day and doesn't answer his calls.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Bo-nui tells Soo-ho how she really feels but asks him to forget about her. But when Bo-ra opens her eyes Bo-nui asks him to be her talisman again.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Bo-nui draws Soo-ho's anger after trying to help his mother reconcile their family. A picture of Bo-nui and Gun-wook together appears online.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Soo-ho can't stand being apart from Bo-nui and comes back from his trip early. After spending the night at her place he makes an announcement at work.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Soo-ho loses his entire fortune and resigns from the company. Ryang-ha invites him to stay at his place, but Soo-ho worries about Bo-nui being aloof.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: After Soo-ho shields Bo-nui and gets hit by a car, Bo-nui blames herself for everything and runs away from Soo-ho and the company.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Bo-nui is living with Bo-ra and teaching computers to the elderly as she plans a new game, while Soo-ho has started over at a new company.
